content.text:
I found no working photoanode in this La–Sb oxide library. All three merit measurements came back at essentially zero EQE. I submitted **index 20 (La 0.52 / Sb 0.48)** as best only because its 0.0019% is the highest of the three.

| Index | Composition (La / Sb) | Why I measured it | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 25 | 0.38 / 0.62 | Target phase La3Sb5O12: stable in the stability model, predicted band gap 2.26 eV (close to the 2.1 eV light) | −0.0009 |
| 12 | 0.74 / 0.26 | Target phase La3SbO3: stable, predicted gap 1.7–2.2 eV depending on the method, which brackets 2.1 eV | −0.0063 |
| 20 | 0.52 / 0.48 | Model's top unexplored pick (it suggested index 19; I took the neighbour closest to LaSbO4), though LaSbO4's predicted gap is 2.65 eV, too wide to absorb | 0.0019 |

- **Most phases can't absorb the light.** The other oxidized La–Sb phases are predicted to have band gaps of about 2.6–4.4 eV, too wide for 2.1 eV light. The one phase predicted to have almost no gap (La9Sb5O5, around index 16) behaves like a metal, which can't work as a photoanode.
- **I couldn't confirm which phases actually formed.** I ran XRD on indices 12 and 25, but neither pattern matched any reference phase well (all similarity scores below 0.3). So I can't tell whether the films really are the phases the predictions were based on.
- **Most of the library is unmeasured.** The whole La-rich end (indices 0–11) and most compositions in between were never tested. I can't rule out a better composition there, but nothing in the model predictions pointed to one.
- **Budget:** all 3 merit measurements are used; 3 of the 5 XRD measurements were left unused.
